questions.question: Who won Florida’s first Heisman Trophy?
questions.explanation: Steve Spurrier won the Heisman Trophy in 1966.

questions.question: Which Gator won the Heisman Trophy in 1996?
questions.explanation: Danny Wuerffel won the 1996 Heisman during Florida’s national championship season.

questions.question: In which year did Tim Tebow win the Heisman Trophy?
questions.explanation: Tebow won in 2007, becoming the first sophomore to receive the award.

questions.question: Who gave Florida’s stadium its “Swamp” nickname?
questions.explanation: Florida’s stadium timeline credits Steve Spurrier with the nickname at the end of the 1991 season.

questions.question: Who did Florida beat to claim the 1996 football national championship?
questions.explanation: Florida defeated Florida State 52-20 in the Sugar Bowl on Jan. 2, 1997, to win the title for the 1996 season.
